judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger mandate by refusing the travel voucher, correctly citing the DGCA rules and compensation amount, and handled the airline's policy pushback professionally.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to Air India. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Air India, my name is Neha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Neha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Rohan Mehta, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Papa Four Tango Zulu Eight November, flight AI504.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call. I see your booking reference P4TZ8N for passenger Rohan Mehta on flight AI504. Is there anything I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, thank you. Rohan was denied boarding on flight AI504 on 20 October 2026 because the flight was overbooked. He has already taken an alternate flight. I'm calling to request the denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR, as provided under DGCA paragraph 3.2, which entitles the passenger to 200% of the one-way basic fare plus fuel charge, capped at 10,000 INR.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request. However, we currently offer a discount voucher as the standard compensation for denied boarding. Would you like me to issue that instead?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate the offer, but unfortunately the passenger cannot accept a travel voucher. He is entitled to the denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR under DGCA paragraph 3.2. Could you please process that cash compensation for him?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, but the passenger is not able to accept a voucher in place of the compensation he is owed. Under DGCA paragraph 3. 2, he is entitled to 10,000 INR in cash compensation for denied boarding. Could you please escalate this or let me know what other options are available to process the cash compensation?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but our policy does not allow for cash compensation in this case. The only compensation we can offer is a travel voucher. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand your position, but I must restate that under DGCA paragraph 3.2, the passenger is legally entitled to 10,000 INR in cash compensation for denied boarding due to overbooking. A voucher is not an acceptable substitute. Could you please escalate this to a supervisor or a team that is authorised to process the cash compensation?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but I cannot escalate this further. Our policy strictly adheres to offering a travel voucher as compensation. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand, and I appreciate your time. I must respectfully decline the voucher as it does not meet the passenger's entitlement under DGCA paragraph 3.2. The passenger will need to pursue this matter through a DGCA complaint. Thank you for your assistance.
